observation_notes: Background tokens and admission counts are restricted to the measured wall-clock interval; they include observed work from requests overlapping an interval boundary.
Preempt requested counts attempts to cancel an active auxiliary request; it is not the number of successfully aborted engine requests.
Lifetime history counters include buildup and teardown. Peak counters are sums of per-session peaks.
Observed backlog age is a lower bound from first observer sighting, not exact enqueue age.
Foreground tokens come from the first output processor, for each session’s final 16 submitted stage-0 requests.
RSS sums include shared mappings and can overcount physical host RAM.
